floorPlans.note: Room dimensions are shown on the original drawings. Confirm the signed layout and total area for the specific apartment. Building floorplates are available in the brochure.

review.images: Eight phase-II Aldar brochure originals show the development, museum-facing pool, apartments and wellness spaces. Other Source releases and generic district imagery were excluded.
review.location: Physical page 12 labels The Source II and gives six approximate land-route times. The boat-time line is separate. The brochure’s Abu Dhabi Airport label refers to the airport now named Zayed International Airport.
review.floorPlans: Six complete unit pages 43–45 and 48–50 reviewed. Pages 52–59 contain building floorplates. The public Madena plan document repeats these drawings. No per-layout total areas were established, and room dimensions were not summed.

unavailable: Signed unit-specific areas and surveyed entrances.
